question_text: What did the speaker do after he made the discovery of the footprint?

subject: English
question_text: What did he think would happen if the savages had seen his home?
guide_solution: He thought that if the savages had seen his home then they would certainly return in large number to destroy his home and carry off his animals. 163 they came near him, they found no wolf there and the boy laughed at them. The villagers were fooled by the cunning boy. So, they went away. After a few days, he made the same fun. The villagers came again to help him but found no wolf there. The boy continued doing it for several days. Each time the villagers were befooled. They found no wolf and went home vexed. But one day a wolf really fell upon the sheep and began to kill his sheep. The boy became very afraid and cried, "Wolf! Wolf! Help! Help! A wolf is in my sheep! Come and help me!" The villagers heard him but they thought it was his another fun. No one came to help him. The wolf feasted on the sheep and finally killed the shepherd. Thus the boy lost his life by telling lies.  Title : A Liar Shepherd
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 118 — Pirojpur Govt. Girls' High School

subject: English
question_text: The pie-chart below shows the choice of profession of
stimulus: young generation. Now describe it in your own words. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart shows the passing rate of different subjects in class ten in the half yearly exam of 2015 in Bogra Govt. Girls' High School, Bogra. It represents the passing rate of the four subjects. It points out that highest number of students passed in Bangla and it was 77%. The second highest was in English and 55% students passed in that subject. Only 42% students passed in Science and it was the third highest in terms of passing rate. The lowest number of student passed in Mathematics and it was only 38%. The pie chart makes it clear that the students of class ten of Bogra Govt. Girls' High School were very much week in Mathematics and Science. Almost half of them failed in English. So, they were also weak in English. In Bangla, they were much stronger then other subjects although there was scope for improvement..
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 118 — Pirojpur Govt. Girls' High School
